The rest are scored on the road itself: how few side roads join it, whether the curves or the limit set the pace, and how little is built up along it. At the 55 mph limit its corners still ask for about 0.64 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace. Most of it has no posted limit on the map, so this assumes 55 mph.
